description: This file contains the implementation of the Subscription model class within the Opencart eCommerce platform. It provides methods to add, edit, retrieve, and manage subscriptions related to checkout processes, including handling subscription status, history, and timing details.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing subscription entities in the checkout process, including CRUD operations, status management, and timing updates.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Adds a new subscription record to the database with provided data, including handling trial and regular durations, and schedules the next date.

methods.name: editSubscription
methods.description: Updates an existing subscription record identified by subscription ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes a subscription record associated with a specific order ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptionByOrderProductId
methods.description: Retrieves subscription data based on order ID and order product ID, decoding JSON fields for options and payment/shipping methods.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Logs a change in subscription status, optionally notifying the customer and updating the status in the main subscription record.

methods.name: editSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Updates the subscription status ID for a given subscription.

methods.name: editTrialRemaining
methods.description: Updates the remaining trial period for a subscription.

methods.name: editDateNext
methods.description: Sets or updates the next scheduled date for the subscription renewal or billing.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscriptions with optional filtering by ID, order ID, or order product ID, including joined customer data and status labels.
